npcs.name: Viarmo
npcs.greet: Welcome to the Bards College, the oldest school of song in Skyrim. Mind the lute strings; they bite.

relics.name: King Olaf's Verse
relics.desc: The lost Edda of King Olaf One-Eye, in his own scratchy hand.

relics.name: Pantea's Flute
relics.desc: A silver flute that belonged to the College's finest musician.

relics.name: Finn's Lute
relics.desc: A lute carved by the bard Finn. The strings still hold their tune.

relics.name: Rjorn's Drum
relics.desc: A war drum. Rjorn played it while the hagravens screamed.

olaf_rises: Free me, and I'll sing the truth of Olaf One-Eye one last time. He stole my verse and buried me in the dark for it.
You'll not have it! I am King! I am the hero of the songs!
burning: Down on the Solitude square, an effigy of King Olaf burns, and the whole city sings your restored verse.
Listen to them! Two hundred years since anyone sang it right. You've saved the festival, and maybe the College.

quests.title: Tending the Flames
quests.offer: How do I join the Bards College?
quests.pitch: We'd need a reason to let you in. Here's one: the King Olaf's Fire festival is banned, unless I can show the Jarl the lost Edda of King Olaf. It's said to lie in Dead Men's Respite. Bring it back.
quests.desc: Viarmo, headmaster of the Bards College, wants King Olaf's lost verse from Dead Men's Respite, to win back the city's festival and give me my place at the College.

objectives.text: Take King Olaf's verse from his tomb

objectives.topic: King Olaf's verse. I have it.
objectives.reply: Half rotten and half in riddles. Perfect. I'll write the rest myself, and the Jarl will have her festival. Welcome to the College, bard.

quests.title: Pantea's Flute
quests.offer: Do you have any work for a bard?
quests.pitch: Pantea lent her flute to an apprentice who took it to Ilinalta's Deep, on the lake. He never came back. The flute should.
quests.desc: Pantea Ateia's flute was lost in Ilinalta's Deep, a drowned fort on Lake Ilinalta.

objectives.text: Bring the flute to the Bards College
objectives.reply: She'll weep, and then she'll play. Thank you.

quests.title: Finn's Lute
quests.pitch: Finn's lute. A student took it into the Reach, to Dead Crone Rock. The Forsworn live there. Be careful.
quests.desc: Finn's lute lies in Dead Crone Rock, in the Forsworn-held hills of the Reach.

objectives.text: Bring the lute to the Bards College
objectives.reply: Still in tune! Finn built well.

quests.title: Rjorn's Drum
quests.pitch: Rjorn's drum is in Hag Rock Redoubt. Hagravens. I'd go myself if I weren't a coward.
quests.desc: Rjorn's drum is in Hag Rock Redoubt, a ruin in the Reach overrun by hagravens.

objectives.text: Bring the drum to the Bards College
objectives.reply: All three instruments, home at last. The College owes you more than I can pay, but here's what I can.
